desc: Tang Taizi, the prince of the Eastern Sacred Empire, was born at the wrong time. With his country destroyed and his family lost, he lived in a remote border town under the care of his wet nurse. She raised him devotedly, hoping he would one day shoulder the grand duty of restoring his fallen kingdom
